title: No Stitcher
subtitle: Stitcher off at boot and out of the menu.
description: Turns off Stitcher: its service (blm_ira_stitcher) and backend (irsstitcher_server) do not start at boot, MMUI no longer loads its screen module, and the Stitcher entry leaves the Entertainment list. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.
